Named for one of [[Droknar|its most beloved kings]], the Forge has never once been taken by an enemy nation.}} [[Droknar's Forge]] is the town for the [[Shiverpeak Mountains]] region of [[Tyria]]. ==Getting there== Droknar's Forge can be reached by one of two methods: *Completing [[the Dragon's Lair]] mission. *Leaving [[Beacon's Perch]] using the southern exit. This requires either fighting your way or [[run]]ning/getting run (the popular [[Droks run]]) through [[Lornar's Pass]], [[Dreadnought's Drift]], [[Snake Dance]] and [[Talus Chute]] (more if going through [[Grenth's Footprint]]). The explorable areas being densely populated with foes and having limited party options leaving from Beacon's Perch, the run is usually much faster and easier. ==Quests== *[[Captain Hugo Bronzebeard]]
